svg.title: Tiling a product larger than the array into output tiles and K chunks
svg.desc: C, 8 by 8, splits into four N by N output tiles. The inner dimension K = 12 splits into chunks of K_MAX = 8 and 4. Each tile takes one normal run per first chunk and one accumulate run per later chunk. Example: tile C11 needs run 1 on A rows 4 to 7, k 0 to 7 and B k 0 to 7, columns 4 to 7 with a normal start, then run 2 on the k 8 to 11 chunk with accumulate high and k_len 4.
